product_metadata.title: Elegant Home Fashions Chesterfield Wooden Floor Cabinet with Waffle Glass Door, Espresso
features: STYLISH FLOOR CABINET: Features a sleek espresso finish with a waffle-texture glass door and a double-plated knob for a beautiful addition to your space
ADJUSTABLE STORAGE: Includes an adjustable shelf to help reduce clutter and keep your home tidy
DURABLE DESIGN: Constructed from durable engineered wood to provide long-lasting use
EASY INSTALLATION: Easy, step-by-step instructions and all of the hardware needed for installation are included for quick assembly
DIMENSIONS: H30.5 x L13 x W13.5 Inches. Weight: 27.5 lbs.
description: Upgrade your home storage while adding classic decor with the Elegant Home Fashions Chesterfield Wooden Floor Cabinet with Waffle Glass Door. This decorative cabinet features a sleek espresso finish with a waffle-texture glass door and a double-plated knob for a beautiful addition to your space. The included adjustable shelf helps to reduce clutter and keep your home tidy. Constructed from durable engineered wood, this floor cabinet is built to provide you with long-lasting organization. Easy, step-by-step instructions and all of the hardware needed for installation are included for quick assembly. Purchase this stylish cabinet alone or with other items from the Chesterfield collection for a cohesive, updated look. The Elegant Home Fashions Chesterfield Wooden Floor Cabinet with Waffle Glass Door measures 13" x 13.5" x 30.5" to provide accessible storage without taking up too much space in your living area or bathroom. An affordable extravagance. Elegant Home Fashions has been the nation's foremost manufacturer of bathroom accent furniture and bathroom accessories among the United States. Their customers include some of America's finest and most prestigious retailers, department stores, and discount retail chains. Elegant Home Fashions products have traveled the globe to focus on giving their consumers, the best quality and design for their bathroom decor.
